inspectionRules.text: Separar el idioma impreso de cada pieza y el idioma de ROM. Super Mario Land 2 muestra ESP en el cartucho; esto no demuestra textos jugables traducidos.
Un manual FAH y un cartucho NOE son observaciones por separado; no aplanar a un solo pais ni declarar mezcla ilegítima sin contrastar una distribucion documentada.
Un manual vendido solo no es juego + manual. Distinguir las piezas efectivamente vendidas de las mencionadas por un titulo o impresas en la caja.
Priorizar imagenes distintas y legibles. Miniatura y ampliacion de la misma foto no acreditan frontal y trasera; no inventar PEGI ni componentes invisibles.

gameReferences.text: Tetris (GiG Italy): Italian localized packaging is positive evidence. The worker already detected Italy but left a conflict against the Spanish target; no Italian Game Boy catalog entries exist at the pinned snapshot. Do not adopt the worker's alleged PEGI or DMG-TR-ITA-3: neither was independently read in this review. Do not copy the Spanish price to a new Italian entry.

MANUALE DI ISTRUZIONI; cartridge, box and manual visible together.

distributionVariants.limitation: Observed together in this listing; not a factory-pairing certificate or universal inventory.

gameReferences.text: Pinball: Revenge of the Gator: NOE component identified; loose, not game_manual. No Spanish distribution evidence is shown. Do not turn NOE into a universal exclusion of Spanish distribution. This loose component does not establish the packaging market of a complete edition.

Skate or Die: Bad 'N Rad: The listing is game plus manual, not complete. Different component codes must remain separately recorded instead of flattening the set to France. Mixed component codes are not, by themselves, proof of an illegitimate set or a new French edition.

Super Mario Land 2: Recover Spanish entry for Super Mario Land 2. The batch searched Super Mario Land 1, read the code incorrectly and asserted a manual not present. Do not attach this listing to Super Mario Land 1 or infer gameplay Spanish from the cartridge label.

gameReferences.text: Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3: European ficha exists under Super Mario Land 3: Wario Land. The worker's PEGI and Spanish-language observations were not visible.

gameReferences.text: Mickey's Dangerous Chase: UKV cartridge and English-oriented set, not substantiation for the worker's Spain conclusion. Strong UK-edition candidate; a box-flap code was not verified. Photo 10 failed to display and was not reviewed. Do not invent a box code, PEGI or a Spanish back cover.

Tetris Attack: Recover as a loose EUR cartridge, without assigning a Spanish-exclusive distribution from the listing title. An EUR cartridge can have been distributed in Spain; this photograph alone does not demonstrate that national edition.

gameReferences.text: Street Fighter II: European multilingual packaging recognized. State can progress from unknown to box plus game; a complete-set price classification still lacks observed manual evidence. The printed reference to a Dutch/French manual is not proof that a manual is included in this sale. No exclusive France or Spain edition inferred.

Super Hunchback: UKV cartridge and manual agree and identify a UK regional version absent from the pinned Game Boy catalog. Do not invent a box-flap code or migrate the existing Spanish/European records. Photo 11 was not inspected.

gameReferences.text: Quarth: Recognizable USA loose cartridge with an existing USA entry. Not eligible to price the Spanish or European ficha. Recovering the correct region does not authorize changing the worker's daily search scope or starting a USA campaign.

gameReferences.text: Monster Max fridge magnet: Exclude the merchandise listing, not a regional edition to discover. Printed game artwork on merchandise is not evidence for a physical game listing or for its regional packaging.
Waterworld VHS: Exclude a different product category rather than leaving its game condition unresolved. Spanish film packaging says nothing about the Spanish Game Boy release of the same name.

Pokemon Blue (loose cartridge listing): The batch lists this as game_manual. It is loose. The unusual mixed label and listing presentation warrant an originality check before treating it as verified original pricing. Not proven counterfeit by this audit. No PCB or gameplay was inspected. Seller's Spanish-language claim remains attributed, not a verified ROM fact. Presence in ingest.listings is not proof of publication.

Super Mario Land 2 manual only: The batch includes this as Spanish game_manual. Exclude from game-plus-manual pricing: the game itself is not included. FAH manual is neither evidence of a Spanish whole edition nor a reason to update the price of an entire game. Presence in ingest.listings is not proof of publication.
